subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for procurement
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finco.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finco.com
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for procurement

Hi Olga,

We're kicking off procurement for a platform evaluation and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and supporting artifacts to complete our security review. Could you share the latest Type II report (audit period), a bridge letter if the report timing doesn't align with our procurement window, and a controls mapping (how Redwood maps SOC controls to common SIG/CAIQ items)?

Specifically, our team would like:
- The SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and EA notes if applicable
- A bridge letter or confirmation of coverage if report date < our contract start
- Controls mapping (CSV or spreadsheet) matching controls to SIG/CAIQ samples
- Any auditor contact info or scope notes that help with our review

Our preferred transfer method is a secure link (S3/Share) or an NDA-protected portal. We need these artifacts by Friday, 2025-04-18, to keep the procurement timeline.

Attaching our standard intake form for reference (SOC2_Request_Form.pdf). Let me know if you need an NDA or additional approvals.

Thanks,
Emily Carter
Sr. Security Manager — FinCo Financial
security@finco.com

Attachment: SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (1 page, PDF)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finco.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for procurement

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the intake form. We're happy to help and can provide the materials you listed. Quick summary of what we can share this week: 

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20241001.pdf — our latest SOC 2 Type II report (audit period: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31).
- Redwood_Bridge_Letter_template.docx — we can provide a signed bridge letter if you need coverage beyond the audit period.
- Controls_Mapping.csv — maps Redwood controls to common SIG/CAIQ items and includes evidence references (logs, policy locations).

Transfer options (pick one):
1) Secure presigned S3 link (preferred) — we'll generate per-file presigned URLs and a time-limited folder.
2) Encrypted ZIP via our secure share portal — requires a short registration.
3) If an NDA is required, we can route to Legal; otherwise we can share under our standard data-sharing terms.

Suggested one-line reply templates you can use internally if you need to escalate or delegate (short, copy-paste):
- "Redwood provided a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2024 calendar year; copies available via secure link (contact olga.petrov@redwood.com)."
- "Redwood will supply a bridge letter to cover procurement start dates outside the report period — see attached template."

We'll include the auditor firm and scope notes in the package. Connor — can you confirm auditor contact details and attach the controls mapping?

Emily, if Friday (2025-04-18) is the deadline, we can hit that with the presigned link option today if you confirm.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (will send via presigned link): Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20241001.pdf; Redwood_Bridge_Letter_template.docx; Controls_Mapping.csv

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@finco.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for procurement

Hi Olga — that timeline works. A couple quick clarifications: 
1) Will the bridge letter explicitly confirm continuous coverage until a new report is available, or is it limited to scope notes?
2) Do you redact any customer-identifying info in the PDF? Our legal team prefers redacted samples if vendor lists include our competitors.

If you can send the presigned link today, we'll route to procurement and legal. Thanks for the one-line templates — very helpful.

—Emily

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report & evidence for procurement

Hi Emily — short answers and next steps: 

1) Bridge letter scope: our bridge letter confirms that control coverage from the last SOC 2 audit remains materially the same and notes exceptions if present. It does not create a new audit, but it explicitly states the timeframe it covers and whether there were any material changes since the report date. I attached the standard bridge letter template so you can see the language.

2) Redaction: we provide the unredacted report by default under secure transfer, but we can provide a redacted PDF if you'd prefer. Most customers request the full report and we redact only on explicit request (e.g., customer lists).

Next steps:
- We'll prepare presigned S3 links and share a secure bundle by EOD (target: 2025-04-14 17:00 PDT).
- Connor will attach the Controls_Mapping.csv with references to internal evidence locations and auditor scope.
- If FinCo needs an NDA, reply-all and indicate the registering contact and we'll loop Legal.

One-line templates for procurement/legal: 
- "We received Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (2024 audit period) and control mapping; bridge letter available on request."
- "Redwood will provide a redacted copy if required; contact olga.petrov@redwood.com."

Connor, attaching the controls mapping and auditor contact in this thread. Jordan, tagging you to help with any commercial questions procurement raises.

Thanks,
Olga

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20241001.pdf (report, 2.8MB); Redwood_Bridge_Letter_template.docx (1 file); Controls_Mapping.csv (spreadsheet, 24KB)
